blocks.h2: Time for a New Water Heater?

tiles.h3: It's Original to a 1990s or 2000s Home
tiles.body: That's past the typical 8 to 12 year life of a tank.
No repair fixes a rusted-through tank.
More people, more showers, more laundry.

blocks.h2: How We Install Your New Water Heater

steps.body: People, bathrooms and big tubs set the capacity and recovery rate.
New shutoff, connectors, an expansion tank if needed and a gas and vent check.
Drained, removed and the new one tested.

blocks.h2: Water Heater Installs in Algonquin Homes
blocks.intro: With more than half of homes built in the 1990s and 2000s, we replace a lot of original builder-grade heaters here.

items.body: Many heaters sit next to finished rooms. We protect the space during the swap and recommend a drain pan or leak sensor.
If your household has grown, a larger tank, a high-recovery model or a [tankless water heater](/algonquin/tankless-water-heater) may fit better.
We install a drain valve that's easy to flush and check your softener so the new heater lasts.

blocks.h2: Water Heater Installation Questions From Algonquin Homeowners

items.q: What size water heater does my family need?
items.preview: Most families do well with 40 to 50 gallons.
items.answer: Most households of three or four do well with 40 or 50 gallons. Bigger families or big tubs may need more capacity or faster recovery.

items.q: Can you replace it the same day?
items.answer: Often, yes. Standard tanks are usually in stock. Tankless and specialty units may take longer.

items.q: Do I need an expansion tank?
items.preview: If you have a check valve or pressure reducer, usually yes.
items.answer: If your water service has a check valve or pressure reducer, an expansion tank protects the heater from pressure swings. We'll check.

items.q: Should I switch to a power-vent or high-efficiency model?
items.preview: Sometimes. It depends on your venting and goals.
items.answer: It can make sense if your venting needs work anyway or you want lower energy use. We'll explain the trade-offs.

items.q: What does water heater installation cost in Algonquin?
items.preview: It depends on type, size and code work. The price comes first.
items.answer: It depends on the type and size of heater, the venting and any code updates. We quote a flat rate before we start.
